title: NEVERMORE
lines: Nevermore is a video store the size of a city.
It keeps 1,684 shots from 80 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 8 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Heartless Poet surveys the shore”.
The tallest tower is Alice In Wonderland (1915): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1915 or newer than 2020.
The sign most often read here is seed and environment.
